text: – What is the Inner Hive? It’s a subscription service. It’s a secret society. It’s a ragtag group of ne’er-do-wells with ideas that are so crazy, they just might work. It’s the team that literally makes it possible for Tom the Dancing Bug to exist in this world. And YOU are invited to become a member! Every week, you’ll get an email with that week’s Tom the Dancing Bug AT LEAST A DAY BEFORE IT’S PUBLISHED ANYWHERE ONLINE. Plus exclusive commentary, insights, process pics, extra comics, jokes, puzzles, recipes, and all benefits accruing. How can you join? Let me count the ways: No matter how you join, you’ll earn the adoration of a grateful nation and world. Friends of Tom the Dancing Bug : If you don’t want to join the Inner Hive, but want to make a grant to the Tom the Dancing Bug enterprise, you can become a Friend of Tom the Dancing Bug by making a payment of any size HER E . You will get a nifty electronic Thank You message. Thank you for reading this message, and I hope to see you on the team. – Ruben Bolling
